summary: The audit checks one course in each of any four of the five core areas and 135 graduate units, every course letter graded (unless the faculty grant an exception, which you handle by hand) and none below the 100 level. You move in the 18 advanced units of approved science or engineering courses, including courses in two areas outside your specialization. The 3.0 GPA, your research home, the qualifying exam, candidacy, the third- and fourth-year progress reviews, the oral exam and the dissertation are checked by hand.

Which courses are science or engineering and outside the specialization is a judgment, so the student moves them in.
